'''September 2000 Shreveport tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Shreveport, Louisiana on 16 September 2000. [[David Monteiro]] won it. It is known from David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1235">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00d1235/ shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00d1235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Shreveport, Louisiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[David Monteiro]]
